violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was less than 50 parts per million (must be 50-100ppm) and the quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution at the 3-bay sink was observed at below 200 ppm (must be 200-400 ppm). The quaternary sanitizing container was changed at the time of inspection and retested at the proper strength of 200-400 ppm. All equipment is to be properly sanitized in the 3-bay sink dishwasher unit is serviced/repaired. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Walk-in cooler #2 was observed maintaining food temperatures at 42-43 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. PIC instructed to use walk-in cooler #1 for Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) Foods until unit is service/repaired and properly maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees F or below. Per the PIC, walk-in cooler is to be adjusted/serviced/repaired in the off season. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application supplied to the Person in Charge at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025

The following possible sources of contamination were observed... - The paper towel dispensers for the kitchen hand sinks were observed mounted directly over the table where Beverage pitchers are stored. (Paper towel dispensers to be moved or table to be shifted to allow for separation.) - The dry goods storage container used for in-use ingredients was observed to be lacking a lid to protect the open product bags. (Per the PIC, the lid broke and is to be replaced.) New Violation. Correct By: 08/07/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine was observed to have an accumulation of food residue/debris. (Per the PIC, the ice machine is to be thoroughly cleaned.) New Violation. Correct By: 08/21/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, manager certified in food safety that is registered/licensed with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application was supplied at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2024

At the time of inspection, the chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. At the time of inspection, the tubing for the sanitizing cycle was adjusted within the chemical bottle, the dish machine was run several times to prime the sanitizing solution, and the sanitizer was retested and observed at 50-100ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2024

The faucet at the hand sink located nearest the dairy prep area was observed to have a cold water handle that was not working properly to turn on the cold water. Per the PIC, a work order is set for repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the mixer and ice machine were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 07/18/2024

The sinks used for food preparation were observed to be lacking a proper air gap (Currently equipped with an air break). A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2024

The wall in the dishwashing area was observed to have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris (mold/mildew/biofilm). The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2024
